carry_weight_formula: sprint_free_kg = STR * 2 | walk_limit_kg = STR * 6 | abs_max_kg = STR * 9
carry_weight_notes: Average human (STR 5): sprint free up to 10kg, comfortable walking up to 30kg, absolute max 45kg. STR scales all thresholds linearly. Having a backpack is assumed for walk/max limits.

items.name: Work Backpack
items.description: A well-worn laptop backpack. Every pocket and compartment functional. Distributes load across both shoulders. Carries more than it looks like it should.
items.notes: Structural weight counted in total. Without it, loose carrying reduces effective STR for carry purposes by 2.

items.name: Sports Bottle (Full)
items.description: 1.5L sports bottle, filled from the tap. Clean water. The most important thing you own right now.
items.effect: Hydration — roughly 1 day of water if rationed. Each drink restores minor stamina.
items.notes: Can be used as a blunt weapon. Damages container on hard impact.

items.name: Protein Bars
items.description: High-calorie compact food. The reliable, flavourless backbone of an athlete's diet. John has eaten thousands of these.
items.effect: Restores 5 HP or delays hunger for 3 hours. Fast to consume — can eat mid-movement.
items.notes: x3 in inventory. Best calorie-to-speed-of-consumption ratio in the pack.

items.name: Energy Gels
items.description: Runner's fuel. Pure carbohydrates in a sachet. Goes down in seconds, burns fast, crashes hard.
items.effect: +1 Endurance for 20 minutes. Reduces fatigue instantly. Hard crash after: -1 Endurance for 10 min post-effect.
items.notes: Handful in inventory (~6). John knows exactly how these feel. Don't stack more than 2.

items.name: Mixed Nuts
items.description: A 400g bag of mixed nuts. Calorie-dense. Slow to eat in a hurry.
items.effect: Restores 8 HP over 30 minutes. Good sustained nutrition.
items.notes: ~4 servings. Noisy to eat. Not ideal in stealth situations.

items.name: Tinned Sardines
items.description: Canned sardines in oil. High protein, long shelf life, no refrigeration needed. Not glamorous. Effective.
items.effect: Restores 10 HP. Solid protein — reduces Endurance fatigue for 2 hours.
items.notes: x2 tins. Requires tin opener or knife to open.

items.name: Tinned Chickpeas
items.description: Two tins of chickpeas. Solid carbs and protein. Heavy for what they are but very filling.
items.effect: Restores 12 HP. Very filling — eliminates hunger for 6 hours.
items.notes: x2 tins. Heaviest food item per calorie. Consider swapping for lighter options later.

items.name: Peanut Butter
items.description: A 350g jar. Calorie-dense and long-lasting. Excellent fat and protein source. Survivor staple.
items.effect: Restores 8 HP per serving. ~5 servings per jar. Slow digestion — sustains energy for 4 hours.
items.notes: Best calorie-to-weight ratio in the pack. Pairs well with anything.

items.name: Ibuprofen
items.description: Standard anti-inflammatory painkiller. John's relationship with this is long, complicated, and mutually enabling.
items.effect: Reduces Chronic Injury pain penalty by 1 tier for 4 hours. Does not heal — masks. Overuse risks gastric damage and dependency.
items.notes: Do not take on an empty stomach. Do not combine with alcohol. John has probably broken both rules.

items.name: Basic First Aid Kit
items.description: Plasters, antiseptic wipes, bandage rolls, medical tape, scissors. Not a trauma kit. Better than nothing.
items.effect: Restores 15 HP when used on wounds. Prevents infection on open injuries. Requires 2 minutes and free hands.
items.notes: 3 full treatment uses. Cannot be used mid-combat.

items.name: Sports Tape
items.description: Athletic strapping tape. John could apply this in his sleep and probably has.
items.effect: Applied to joint: reduces Chronic Injury penalty by 1 tier. Also useful for binding, securing, field repairs.
items.notes: x2 rolls. John wears one ankle wrap permanently. Versatile — one of the most useful items in the pack.

items.name: Laptop
items.description: Work laptop. Powers on. No internet. Locally functional. Contains IT diagnostic tools, documentation, and software John uses daily.
items.effect: Enables IT skill checks. May interface with found hardware, System terminals, or local networks. Required for certain technical actions.
items.notes: Intel i5, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD. The power bank extends runtime. Keep it charged — electricity won't last forever.

items.name: Battery Bank
items.description: 20,000mAh portable power bank. Currently at 60% charge.
items.effect: Powers laptop (3 hours), phone (1.5 full charges), or other USB devices. 60% = roughly half that.
items.notes: Recharge from wall outlets while power grid is still up. This window will close.

items.name: Kitchen Knife
items.description: A standard household kitchen knife. Not designed as a weapon. Will function as one. John took this from his own flat.
items.durability: Low — not built for combat stress
items.notes: Backup blade. Will chip against bone or hard surfaces. Fastest draw of the knives.

items.name: Chef's Knife
items.description: Heavy professional chef's knife. Long blade, good German steel, solid weight. Someone spent real money on this. It shows.
items.durability: Medium-High — built to last through hard use
items.notes: Best conventional blade in the pack. Long enough to keep something at distance. Balances well in hand.

items.name: Meat Cleaver
items.description: A butcher's cleaver. Heavy, wide, blunt-backed. Built to split things that don't want to be split. Does exactly that.
items.durability: High — built for hard repeated use
items.notes: Highest raw damage of the one-handed weapons. Tiring to swing continuously. John's STR 6 handles the weight without penalty.

items.name: Aluminium Mop Handle
items.description: Lightweight aluminium pole, ~140cm. Hollow but stiff. Excellent reach. Won't shatter. John unscrewed the mop head in the supermarket.
items.durability: Medium — aluminium dents before it breaks
items.special: Reach advantage — can strike targets 1.4m away, keeping them outside arm-grab range.
items.notes: John's football background gives him instinctive lateral movement. Combined with this weapon's reach, he can control spacing effectively.

items.name: Bone Saw
items.description: A butcher's bone saw. Long serrated blade designed to cut through dense material under sustained pressure. Nobody wants to be on the wrong end of this.
items.special: Bleeding — serrated wounds reopen under movement. Target takes 3 HP bleed per turn for 3 turns after hit.
items.notes: Psychological value should not be dismissed. The sound alone is a deterrent.

items.name: Molotov Components
items.description: 2x 70cl bottles of 40% vodka. Each bottle ~700g. Lighter and rag are separate items.
items.special: Area fire on impact (~3m radius). Burn damage on anything in range. Fire persists ~20 seconds. Cannot be un-thrown.
items.notes: x2 Molotovs available. Assemble in ~30 seconds: rag in neck, light, throw. Weight is for both bottles only.

items.name: CO2 Fire Extinguisher
items.description: A CO2 extinguisher from the supermarket wall mount. Heavy steel cylinder. The discharge blinds and disorients at close range. The cylinder itself is a blunt weapon.
items.special: Discharge: blinds and disorients target for 2 turns. Direct cold contact causes frostbite. One use only.
items.notes: Heavy. As the game progresses and better options appear, weight cost may outpace value. But right now it's the best defensive tool in the pack.

items.name: Phone
items.description: John's smartphone. Dead in the normal sense — won't respond to the power button. Turns on only when the System sends a notification. Screen works as a dim torch on minimum brightness.
items.notes: System conduit. Keep it on you. It is how the System reaches you. Do not lose it.

items.name: Apartment Keys
items.description: Keys to John's flat on Karl-Heine-Straße. The flat still exists, still has whatever he left behind, and is still unlocked.
items.notes: The flat had: foam roller, pasta, protein powder, oats, cheese/yoghurt (spoiling), shin pads, spare trainers, training kit.

items.name: Spare Hoodie
items.description: A second hoodie worn over the first. Adds warmth. Provides the bare minimum of padding.
items.effect: Minor cold resistance. Negligible blunt damage reduction (not combat-relevant at this tier).
items.notes: Currently wearing. Weight counted in total.

items.name: Knee Brace
items.description: Medical knee brace. John puts this on before any physical activity without thinking. The motion is as automatic as lacing boots.
items.effect: Worn: reduces Chronic Injury (knee) severity by 1 tier. Without it, Tier 2 exertion triggers Tier 3 penalties.
items.notes: Currently worn. Non-negotiable for John. Weight counted in total.

items.name: Lighter
items.description: Standard disposable lighter. Fuelled. Cheap. Essential.
items.effect: Fire source. Required component for Molotov assembly. General utility — fire, signalling, light.
items.notes: Keep it dry. Keep it away from the vodka until you mean it.

items.name: Cloth Rag
items.description: A strip of cotton cloth. Unremarkable. Required for Molotov assembly.
items.notes: Crafting component only. Part of the Molotov kit.
